tests.scenario_and_expected_result: Submit synthetic form A twice while its first run is delayed. Repeatable mode creates two distinct run IDs with separate delay/action histories;one-time mode enrolls once. Replaying the same submission webhook does not create a third run. Merge or exit one run without cancelling the other inadvertently.

Request synthetic files X and Y. Sending sets pending,uploading X sets partial,and both accepted uploads set complete. A corrupt,rejected or replaced upload cannot silently satisfy required Y. Trigger IS and IS NOT rules against the exact request-template instance;retries create one downstream action.

Use a synthetic two-signer agreement. First signature does not trigger completed-agreement intake. Second valid signature triggers once against the reviewed edition. Decline,expiry,amendment or signer replacement invalidates the appropriate completion state;retain evidence and never treat sending as execution.

Attach synthetic shared rule R-v1 to workflows A and B. Preview a v2 change and its impacted matches before publication. Pin each run’s evaluated version;cloning or deleting a rule cannot silently alter historical eligibility. Reject circular dependencies and preserve workflow-local conditions.

Test synthetic expression (practice=PI OR practice=Immigration) AND amount>100. Show each evaluated clause and final match. Distinguish blank,zero,false and unknown. Reject numeric comparison on text unless conversion is explicit. Mixed trigger families retain their documented grouping;an empty all-matters filter requires a scope preview.

Configure synthetic event-registration,email-open,email-link-click,appointment-created,task-created and task-completed events with stable IDs. An email lacking links cannot yield a click event. Task tags map to the intended type;appointment-created is separate from time-relative scheduling. Invoice-paid trigger is unavailable when the configured payment connector is absent. Preserve evidence;telemetry does not prove human reading or settled payment.

Use synthetic owner A,task assignee B,appointment host C,mentioned user D and conflict creator E. Verify each configured event reaches only its intended recipients. Document/SMS/email-bounce role sets,payment roles,mail-sync user and portal-thread participants are separate. Recheck permissions at dispatch. Keep conflict owner-versus-creator policy unresolved until verified.

Set synthetic event E to in-app only,then email only. Retain prior notifications and apply changes to future events without duplicate delivery. Form-filled email attachment matches the submitted snapshot and authorized matter link. Non-user delivery requires a separately configured communication action;failure alerts respect visibility and retries. A delivered email does not establish that its recipient opened it.

extended_tests.expected: Pause a synthetic run at step2,edit step3 and reactivate. Record pause/resume times and configuration at each step. Targets past step3 retain historical outcomes;targets yet to reach it use the explicitly selected version. A finished target does not restart merely because activation toggled.

Record eligibility blockers separately:pending conflict,wrong matter status or prior completed run. An authorized manual restart creates a distinct run with provenance and action-level idempotency. Repeated form submissions follow F-0374 rather than a global once-only rule.

Send a synthetic form,enter a delay,then receive submission during the delay. Show completion evidence and next-action cancellation eligibility separately from current delay status. At wake-up exit before reminder or branch. A separate completion-triggered workflow creates the review task once;do not expect an earlier no-branch to re-evaluate.

Search synthetic names,email and phone using exact,contains,AND and OR. Show rendered term groups and scope so a name-plus-email exact match cannot silently stand in for an alternative match. Preserve non-match,possible-match and human decision separately;CSV includes the same matched record IDs and evaluation time.

With required email absent,test skip and pause policies explicitly. Skipped is not approved. Empty search cannot become no-conflict automatically. Only a valid completed search with a separately configured policy may yield automated no-result approval;later identity changes require a fresh check.

Deny a synthetic matter and retain its timeline/search history. Normal intake actions stay blocked. If a denied/undecided remediation workflow is configured,make the override specific to that workflow and limit allowed actions. Do not globally disable conflict protection to make a rejection-report workflow run.

Preview all currently eligible synthetic target IDs and count before activation. Immediate mode enrolls that snapshot;future-only excludes preexisting matches. Show concurrent eligibility changes and per-target results. Reactivation resumes existing paused runs without replaying sent actions;no live workflow is activated during this audit.

cases_to_execute.title: Preserve manual and dynamic conflict-query semantics
cases_to_execute.developer_story_extension: As intake staff, I need the exact evaluated query and missing inputs visible before relying on a conflict result.
cases_to_execute.scenario_and_expected_result: Use two synthetic matters with the same name but different email, a known alias and a name-only match. Compare manual exact/contains and explicit AND/OR trees with a dynamic name-plus-email query. Display normalized values and match passages; never treat the narrower combined query’s empty result as proof that no name-only candidate exists. Changing a merge field creates a new evaluated query/version, with the original retained.

Auto-approve with zero matches is disabled unless the required query completed successfully under the approved policy; an error or skipped check cannot qualify.

cases_to_execute.developer_story_extension: As the attorney, I need rejected or undecided intake records preserved while a controlled remediation workflow remains separate from client onboarding.
cases_to_execute.scenario_and_expected_result: Set matter status denied, then undecided, and evaluate an automation whose trigger targets that status with Skip Conflicts enabled and disabled. Preview why it is blocked or eligible. A designated internal remediation branch may run once with restricted recipients and no welcome letter, fee agreement or client-onboarding action. Approval later must re-evaluate the exact current matter/check version; it cannot retroactively rewrite the denied history.
